notes.title: Itemization Update!
notes.notes:
[table noborder="1" colwidth="188,"][tr][td colwidth="188"][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033081/3cb2b9e1d743c4b916d0a2208026f80a59f96f61.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][/td][td][p]Heeeeeello everybody! This is Mike, from Fire News from Fire Flies!
I come to you with the most FIRE update regarding Rine: the Trail of Fireflies!

A whole new update has just dropped...and is FIRE![/p][p]
Check it out for yourselves![/p][p][/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033081/11268087de5adbb611721dff76e0e98d703bdebe.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][table noborder="1" equalcells="1" colwidth="209,"][tr][td colwidth="209"][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033081/e524e1d30616663eaff88cefe45f5210978b212b.png"][/img][/p][/td][td][p][/p][p]With this new update, the shop system has been created, having our fellow firefly Herbert as the star of the event![/p][p]Herbert loves to haggle, so be prepared for some irresistible offers throughout your travels![/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033081/11268087de5adbb611721dff76e0e98d703bdebe.png"][/img][/p][p]If there is a shop, it means that money is involved. So, without further ado, here comes the currency of all the Seven Forests, the Lux tokens! Gather as many of this shining tokens, because they will have a great value in your travels![/p][p][/p][table noborder="1" equalcells="1" colwidth=",,,,"][tr][td][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033081/9cb38c766a29b68978f25de7b665ab2b00dcf8ef.png"][/img]       [/p][/td][td][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033081/62583bd135801f9f51ccf15f15f840039a911611.png"][/img]  [/p][/td][td][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033081/c4dc674e9b9f479bbda0d3f1a1af893c3f15f446.png"][/img][/p][/td][td][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033081/03524cf7d1d4f77b17d63664383cba288146da4e.png"][/img]  [/p][/td][td][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033081/365d33d402bbf10a9cf4da012eff3186201b9a82.png"][/img]    [/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033081/11268087de5adbb611721dff76e0e98d703bdebe.png"][/img][/p][p]From now on, every item will have rarity, helping Rine understand the value of the items he will find! Of course, most of the items available in the Demo will be common, but we will keep you in touch with the new items and their rarity, building up Hype for the upcoming updates![/p][table noborder="1" equalcells="1" colwidth=",,,,"][tr][td][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033081/203d9d29091b735ed22588580fb2855b717e73d2.png"][/img][/p][/td][td][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033081/7f75f345a6a314b929ad5d507d708b3917d2cf01.png"][/img][/p][/td][td][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033081/a7103199fbc840fbec6d04f988924dda4365621c.png"][/img][/p][/td][td][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033081/bb5ba46d130e8e6415b297dbbdd2b17409eb7a73.png"][/img][/p][/td][td][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033081/2638238847eba779f09ef914430994536fed5cc0.png"][/img][/p][/td][/tr][/table][p]Also, a buch of new items have been added on the map for Rine to find... We shall let you explore them and find their quirks! [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033081/11268087de5adbb611721dff76e0e98d703bdebe.png"][/img][/p][p]This being said, this is just the tip of the iceberg! The crafting system will be comming soon, asswell as cooking, fishing, skills and much more![/p][p]Make special fireflies come with Rine in order to help him in crafty ways...because you know, he is a Fox, he cant do much...but the fireflies are there for him...and for you![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]We hope that this update will make you, Vox, more hyped for the game and for the upcoming new releases![/p][p][/p][p]Until next time,[/p][p]This has been Mike, from Fire News from Fire Flies![/p]

notes.title: Sincere Apologies!
notes.notes:
[table noborder=1][tr][td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033081/3cb2b9e1d743c4b916d0a2208026f80a59f96f61.png[/img]
[/td]
[td]Heeeeeello everybody! This is Mike, from Fire News from Fire Flies!
I come to you with the most FIRE update regarding Rine: the Trail of Fireflies!

As the Demo has been played by more and more people, there came to light some mistakes that has been done which stopped many of the players enjoying our game.
[/td][/tr][/table]
The fireflies from all the Seven Forests were sad, the game should be fun and easy to catch up with everybody!
We the fireflies, and the developer want to thank the some of you that told us about the problems!

Also, [b]the developer wishes to send his upmost and sincere apologies[/b]! He worked hard to change some  aspects regarding the tutorial, and fix some glitches... and make the game something which everyone should enjoy!

The update is up and running! Check what is new! And join our [url=https://discord.gg/F2YBdE4K]Discord Server[/url] to tell us about any other improvements that the developer can make!


Until next time,
This has been Mike, from Fire News from Fire Flies!
